_note: Network-wide settings. Hole names are real Martian craters.

deposits._note: How many deposits of each kind a game places, and their size in degrees. Where they go follows the terrain (src/sim/map.ts).

firstSite._note: The first hole sits between these latitudes (#395: 20-25° north, where floor 1 rests at 40-45 °F): of `tries` spots along the band, one on ore, else the lowest without silica; ice and ore are planted under it if the map has none there.

seedKit._note: What a staging bay gathers before a new hole can be founded, and how long a fully staffed bay takes to gather it. It never takes a hole below reserveFraction of a kit's worth of anything. No oxygen: the crew seals the new hole and makes its air on arrival (sim/founding.ts), and the machinery covers its electrolyzer, scrubber and recycler. setsUp: rooms the kit brings ready-made, set up by the crew on arrival with the landing kit (a heater for floor 1, #403).
